title: [Bookgolas Web Parity 22] Implement timer/session behavior and floating timer bar

red.observed: Before implementation, npm reported Missing script: test:timer.

details: The strict timer contract, browser state, fixture state machine and private route suites passed 4 Vitest files and 14 tests.
The acceptance script covers 30-second discard, eight-hour cap, idempotency, verified owner scope, logout cleanup, localized paths and private no-store responses.
The package negative command passed minimum, duplicate, logout and over-max fixture modes.
The happy surface passed start, pause, resume, refresh restoration, stop persistence, the eight-hour cap and duplicate replay.
The failure surface passed minimum-session discard, duplicate stop replay and logout local-state cleanup.
Parity matrix passed 20 routes, 53 overlays and 8 capabilities; all 59 parity negative fixtures passed.
BLDS React parity, BLDS negative, SSR state, UI primitive, UI primitive negative, progress UI, progress UI negative and timer contracts passed.
